question: For each pizza order, provide a single result row with the row ID, order ID, customer ID, pizza name, and final set of ingredients. The final ingredients are determined by starting with the standard toppings from the pizza’s recipe, removing any excluded toppings, and adding any extra toppings. Present the ingredients in a string starting with the pizza name followed by ': ', with ingredients listed in alphabetical order. Ingredients appearing multiple times (e.g., from standard and extra toppings) should be prefixed with '2x' and listed first, followed by single-occurrence ingredients, both in alphabetical order. Group by row ID, order ID, pizza name, and order time to ensure each order appears once. Sort results by row ID in ascending order. Assign pizza_id 1 to 'Meatlovers' pizzas and pizza_id 2 to all others.
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY order_id, pizza_id) as row_id,
    order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, exclusions, extras, order_time
  FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders
),
standard AS (
  SELECT 
    b.row_id, b.order_id, b.customer_id, b.pizza_id, b.order_time,
    CAST(TRIM(t2.value) AS INTEGER) as topping_id,
    t.topping_name
  FROM base b
  JOIN pizza_recipes r ON r.pizza_id = b.pizza_id
  JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(regexp_split_to_array(r.toppings, ',\s*')) AS t2(value) ON true
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = CAST(TRIM(t2.value) AS INTEGER)
),
excluded AS (
  SELECT 
    b.row_id,
    CAST(TRIM(t2.value) AS INTEGER) as excluded_topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(regexp_split_to_array(NULLIF(b.exclusions, ''), ',')) AS t2(value) ON true
  WHERE b.exclusions IS NOT NULL AND b.exclusions != ''
),
extra AS (
  SELECT 
    b.row_id,
    CAST(TRIM(t2.value) AS INTEGER) as extra_topping_id
  FROM base b
  JOIN LATERAL UNNEST(regexp_split_to_array(NULLIF(b.extras, ''), ',')) AS t2(value) ON true
  WHERE b.extras IS NOT NULL AND b.extras != ''
),
all_toppings AS (
  SELECT s.row_id, s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.pizza_id, s.order_time, s.topping_name
  FROM standard s
  LEFT JOIN excluded e ON e.row_id = s.row_id AND e.excluded_topping_id = s.topping_id
  WHERE e.excluded_topping_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.row_id, b.order_id, b.customer_id, b.pizza_id, b.order_time, t.topping_name
  FROM extra e
  JOIN pizza_toppings t ON t.topping_id = e.extra_topping_id
  JOIN base b ON b.row_id = e.row_id
),
counted AS (
  SELECT row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name, COUNT(*) as cnt
  FROM all_toppings
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time, topping_name
),
named AS (
  SELECT 
    row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
    topping_name,
    cnt,
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN '2x' || topping_name ELSE topping_name END as formatted_ingredient,
    CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END as sort_key
  FROM counted
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time,
    string_agg(formatted_ingredient, ', ' ORDER BY sort_key ASC, formatted_ingredient ASC) as ingredients
  FROM named
  GROUP BY row_id, order_id, customer_id, pizza_id, order_time
),
with_pizza_info AS (
  SELECT 
    row_id,
    order_id,
    customer_id,
    pizza_id,
    CASE WHEN pizza_id = 1 THEN 'Meatlovers' ELSE 'Vegetarian' END as pizza_name,
    ingredients
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT 
  row_id,
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  pizza_name,
  pizza_name || ': ' || ingredients as ingredients
FROM with_pizza_info
ORDER BY row_id
